status: Example cases on public ML papers. Replace or extend them with cases from your own searches.
rules: Give the driver only `question` (or `paraphrase`), `profile` and the budget. Never the targets.
Run each case twice: once with `question`, once with `paraphrase` (written to avoid the targets' vocabulary).
Grade with: python tools/grade_hunt.py docs/confidence/cases.json CASE_ID HUNT_ID
Record by hand: how many shortlist entries are irrelevant.

cases.question: Has anyone made linear RNNs solve parity and other state-tracking tasks by changing the range of the recurrent transition?
cases.paraphrase: Recurrent layers whose memory update is allowed to reverse its sign, so a fast parallel-trainable recurrence can count modulo two: has this been done?

targets.title: Unlocking State-Tracking in Linear RNNs Through Negative Eigenvalues
DeltaProduct: Improving State-Tracking in Linear RNNs via Householder Products

cases.question: What should I read to understand grokking?
cases.paraphrase: What should I read about networks that suddenly generalize long after they have memorised a small algorithmic training set?

targets.title: Grokking: Generalization Beyond Overfitting on Small Algorithmic Datasets
Progress measures for grokking via mechanistic interpretability

cases.question: What is new on preventing representation collapse in JEPA-style world models?
cases.paraphrase: Recent ways to stop joint-embedding predictive models from mapping every input to nearly the same vector, without stop-gradient or EMA tricks.

targets.title: LeJEPA: Provable and Scalable Self-Supervised Learning Without the Heuristics
LeWorldModel: Stable End-to-End Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture from Pixels

cases.question: Find the paper arguing that state space models like Mamba are no better than transformers at tracking state, with a circuit-complexity argument.
cases.paraphrase: The paper saying recurrent sequence models with diagonal structure sit in the same complexity class as attention and so cannot really track state.

targets.title: The Illusion of State in State-Space Models

cases.question: Has anyone built probes that track which concept an LLM is thinking about as it reads text, token by token?
cases.paraphrase: Detecting, from a language model's hidden activations, what idea it currently has in mind while processing a passage.

targets.title: What are They Thinking? Delineation, Probing and Tracking of Concepts in LLMs
